injury_reports.name: Jake Ferguson
injury_reports.summary: Ferguson failed to haul in his lone target during Monday's 38-21 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Ryan Flournoy
injury_reports.summary: Flournoy secured all four targets for 70 yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Goodson
injury_reports.summary: Goodson turned 10 carries into 38 yards and returned two kickoffs for 42 yards during the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday.

injury_reports.name: CeeDee Lamb
injury_reports.summary: Lamb brought in five of 12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: James Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: The Cowboys elevated Mitchell from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: George Pickens
injury_reports.summary: Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) is expected to play Sunday against the Cardinals, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Dak Prescott
injury_reports.summary: Prescott completed 15 of 27 passes for 212 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for eight yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night. He also had a two-point conversion run.

injury_reports.name: Luke Schoonmaker
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brevyn Spann-Ford
injury_reports.summary: Spann-Ford finished with two catches for 11 yards on two targets in Monday's 38-21 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: KaVontae Turpin
injury_reports.summary: Turpin (ribs) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Javonte Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams rushed 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kenny Clark
injury_reports.summary: Clark (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Downs
injury_reports.summary: Downs (ankle) has no designation for Sunday's clash against the Cardinals, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Cobie Durant
injury_reports.summary: Durant (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Monday's game against Philadelphia, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: P.J. Locke
injury_reports.summary: Locke (foot) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, but he's still listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: DeMarvion Overshown
injury_reports.summary: Overshown posted six tackles (five solo) and two pass defenses (including one interception) during the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Quinnen Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (hamstring) is set to play Sunday against Arizona, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Dee Winters
injury_reports.summary: Winters (calf) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Aubrey
injury_reports.summary: Aubrey made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three PAT tries in Monday's 38-21 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Bullard
injury_reports.summary: Bullard (calf) was designated to return from injured reserve by the Cowboys on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Marist Liufau
injury_reports.summary: Liufau (forearm) has been downgraded from questionable to out ahead of Monday night's game against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier (toe) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest at Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Beck (back) practiced in full Thursday, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Bourne caught three of six targets for nine yards during Sunday's 30-16 loss versus the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Jacoby Brissett
injury_reports.summary: Brissett completed 27 of 48 passes for 272 yards and a touchdown while rushing seven times for 16 yards in Sunday's 30-16 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Brooks
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals placed Brooks (wrist) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Hjalte Froholdt
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jon Gaines II
injury_reports.summary: Gaines (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Elijah Higgins
injury_reports.summary: Higgins caught all three of his targets for 17 yards and made one tackle on kick coverage in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) has been cleared to return from a two-game absence to face the Cowboys on Sunday, so Knight is expected to revert to rotational role in the Cardinals' backfield.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiyah Love
injury_reports.summary: Love (ankle) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game at Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson (ribs) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game in Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Kenny Yeboah
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals elevated Yeboah from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Budda Baker
injury_reports.summary: Baker logged two tackles (one solo) during Sundays' 30-16 loss to Denver.

injury_reports.name: Jack Gibbens
injury_reports.summary: Gibbens recorded seven tackles (four solo) in a 30-16 loss to the Broncos on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Max Melton
injury_reports.summary: Melton (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Walter Nolen III
injury_reports.summary: Nolen (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

injury_reports.name: Mack Wilson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Wilson (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Wingard
injury_reports.summary: Wingard (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and converted his only extra-point attempt during Sunday's 30-16 loss to Denver.

injury_reports.name: James Conner
injury_reports.summary: When asked Monday if Conner (foot) will play this season, coach Mike LaFleur said "potentially," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tip Reiman
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur stated he's "not too sure" if Reiman (ankle) will play this season, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.summary: Godwin secured four of five targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Luke Goedeke
injury_reports.summary: Goedeke (calf) is officially questionable for Sunday's Week 8 matchup against Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Ted Hurst III
injury_reports.summary: Hurst didn't record a catch on one target in Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Bucky Irving
injury_reports.summary: Irving rushed 24 times for 106 yards and two touchdowns while bringing in one of two targets for four yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Tampa Bay.

injury_reports.name: Tez Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught both of his targets for 33 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Baker Mayfield
injury_reports.summary: Mayfield, who was a full practice participant Wednesday, said that he's still taking a day-by-day approach when it comes to wearing a glove to protect his dislocated right thumb, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Cade Otton
injury_reports.summary: Otton failed to catch his only target during Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Sean Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker rushed seven times for 52 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 43-13 win against Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Zyon McCollum
injury_reports.summary: McCollum (illness) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Panthers, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

injury_reports.name: Tykee Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith posted seven tackles (one solo), an interception and a blocked extra-point attempt Sunday in a 43-13 Week 7 win against Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Josiah Trotter
injury_reports.summary: Trotter (illness) was a full participant at the Buccaneers' practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Winfield (ribs) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Chase McLaughlin
injury_reports.summary: McLaughlin made both of his field-goal tries while going 5-for-5 on PATs during Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Josh Hayes
injury_reports.summary: Hayes suffered a small setback in his recovery from a knee injury, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Rozeboom
injury_reports.summary: Rozeboom (finger) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: David Sills V
injury_reports.summary: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Jahan Dotson

injury_reports.name: Khalil Herbert

injury_reports.name: Austin Hooper

injury_reports.name: Nick Muse

injury_reports.name: Brian Robinson Jr.

injury_reports.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
injury_reports.summary: Zaccheaus (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jessie Bates III
injury_reports.summary: Bates registered nine tackles (two solo), two defensed passes (including an interception) and one forced fumble Sunday in a 29-20 victory over San Francisco.

injury_reports.name: Billy Bowman Jr.

injury_reports.name: Kendal Daniels
injury_reports.summary: Daniels (Achilles) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Divine Deablo
injury_reports.summary: Deablo (forearm) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: C.J. Henderson

injury_reports.name: Spencer Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown (back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Keon Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman brought in four of six targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Ray Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis (illness) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Ty Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson logged a three-yard carry and caught both of his targets for 24 yards during the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dalton Kincaid
injury_reports.summary: The Bills are optimistic that Kincaid (chest), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, will be able to play, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Dawson Knox
injury_reports.summary: Knox caught his only target for no gain during Sunday's 33-30 win at Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: DJ Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (shoulder) remains listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens but is expected to play, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Joshua Palmer
injury_reports.summary: Palmer caught one of two targets for 37 yards during Buffalo's 33-30 win over Las Vegas on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dee Alford
injury_reports.summary: Alford (ankle) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Te'Cory Couch
injury_reports.summary: The Bills signed Couch (hamstring) off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Sam Franklin Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The NFL reduced Franklin's discipline from a one-game suspension to a fine of $14,926, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Greg Gaines
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: C.J. Gardner-Johnson
injury_reports.summary: reserve-sus

injury_reports.name: Davison Igbinosun
injury_reports.summary: Defensive coordinator Jim Leonhard praised Igbinosun's play earlier this week and plans to keep giving the rookie a good amount of playing time, Alec White of the Bills' official site reports. Said Leonard, "I think what he's done the last couple weeks, he's definitely earned a high majority of the snaps at the corner position. I know what I'm getting, play in and play out."

injury_reports.name: Ed Oliver
injury_reports.summary: Oliver (knee) was a full participant at the Bills' practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: TJ Parker
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Dorian Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams logged five tackles (three solo) and one pass defensed for an interception in the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Bass
injury_reports.summary: Bass converted all four of his field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point tries during Buffalo's win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tyrell Shavers
injury_reports.summary: The Bills designated Shavers (knee) to return from the reserve/PUP list Wednesday, but he will not play against the Ravens on Sunday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

items.name: Dalton Kincaid
items.impact: Reported Questionable: TE starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.impact: Reported Questionable: CB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

injury_reports.name: Mark Andrews
injury_reports.summary: Andrews caught three of four targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Rashod Bateman
injury_reports.summary: Bateman caught two of four targets for 33 yards during Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Josh Cuevas
injury_reports.summary: Cuevas caught two of three targets for 35 yards during the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Zay Flowers
injury_reports.summary: Flowers brought in eight of 11 targets for 137 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Derrick Henry
injury_reports.summary: Henry rushed 17 times for 45 yards and brought in one of two target for four yards in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Matt Hibner
injury_reports.summary: Hibner (hand) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Justice Hill
injury_reports.summary: Hill took three carries for seven yards and caught three of four targets for 26 yards during Sunday's 35-13 loss versus the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Huntley
injury_reports.summary: Huntley will be the backup quarterback against the Bills on Sunday after Lamar Jackson (ankle) was cleared to return from a three-game absence, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Olaivavega Ioane
injury_reports.summary: Ioane (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's battle against Buffalo.

injury_reports.name: Lamar Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter confirmed Friday that Jackson (ankle) will play in Sunday's game at Buffalo, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Jurgens
injury_reports.summary: Jurgens (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
injury_reports.summary: Lane caught three of five targets for 25 yards during Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Ronnie Stanley
injury_reports.summary: Stanley (toe) practiced in full Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Hamilton
injury_reports.summary: Hamilton (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Jaylinn Hawkins
injury_reports.summary: Hawkins (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Buffalo.

injury_reports.name: Roquan Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (knee) was limited in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Tampa
injury_reports.summary: The Ravens activated Tampa (knee) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Broderick Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Washington (ankle) logged a full practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Loop
injury_reports.summary: Loop went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made his only PAT during Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Adam Randall
injury_reports.summary: Randall (neck) wasn't activated from injured reserve Saturday and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Bills, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Tavius Robinson
injury_reports.summary: The Ravens placed Robinson (pectoral) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Chase Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown rushed 11 times for 39 yards and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Joe Burrow
injury_reports.summary: Burrow completed 22 of 30 passes for 292 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for 12 yards in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Marr Chase
injury_reports.summary: Chase (ankle) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Mike Gesicki
injury_reports.summary: Gesicki caught his only target for a six-yard touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Cam Grandy
injury_reports.summary: The Bengals signed Grandy off the Vikings' practice squad Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury_reports.name: Tee Higgins
injury_reports.summary: Higgins secured six of seven targets for 148 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dohnte Meyers
injury_reports.summary: Meyers failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Samaje Perine
injury_reports.summary: Perine rushed four times for 16 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Drew Sample
injury_reports.summary: Sample caught both of his targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Colbie Young
injury_reports.summary: Young (knee) was not listed on the Bengals' injury report Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Barrett Carter
injury_reports.summary: Carter recorded nine tackles (three solo) and a pass defense during Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Bryan Cook
injury_reports.summary: Cook recorded nine tackles (six solo), including 0.5 sacks, during the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Dugger
injury_reports.summary: Dugger (quadriceps) won't play in Sunday's game against the Titans, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Joe Giles-Harris
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Demetrius Knight Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Knight totaled eight tackles (two solo) and an interception during the Bengals' win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Boye Mafe
injury_reports.summary: Mafe finished Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens with five tackles (three solo), including 1.5 sacks.

injury_reports.name: Evan McPherson
injury_reports.summary: McPherson did not attempt a field goal and made all five of his PATs in Sunday's 35-13 win over Baltimore.

injury_reports.name: Erick All Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Andrei Iosivas
injury_reports.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

items.name: Joe Giles-Harris
items.impact: Reported Questionable: depth at LB may be affected.

items.name: Kyle Dugger
items.impact: Reported Out: depth at S may be affected.

items.name: Andrei Iosivas
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at WR may be affected.

items.name: Erick All Jr.
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at TE may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Elic Ayomanor
injury_reports.summary: Carnell Tate (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, leaving Ayomanor and Wan'Dale Robinson as the top wide receivers in the passing game, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Gunnar Helm
injury_reports.summary: Helm caught three of four targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Tony Pollard
injury_reports.summary: Pollard will have a chance to easily pace the Titans backfield against Cincinnati on Sunday due to the absence of Tyjae Spears (knee), Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Restrepo
injury_reports.summary: The Titans elevated Restrepo from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Calvin Ridley
injury_reports.summary: Ridley (hip) is in line to play in Sunday's game against the Bengals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson and the other pass catchers will operate in elevated roles against the Bengals on Sunday due to the absence of rookie fourth overall pick Carnell Tate (shoulder), Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyjae Spears
injury_reports.summary: Spears (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Carnell Tate
injury_reports.summary: Tate (shoulder) will not play against the Bengals on Sunday but is expected to be back in action following the Titans' bye for Week 10 against the Jaguars on Sunday, Nov. 15, Paul Kuharsky of PaulKuharsky.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Ward
injury_reports.summary: Ward completed 20 of 31 passes for 181 yards with an interception in Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland. He added five yards on two carries.

injury_reports.name: Tony Adams
injury_reports.summary: Adams (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: John Franklin-Myers
injury_reports.summary: Franklin-Myers (groin) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Hill logged 12 tackles (five solo) and one forced fumble during the Titans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Amani Hooker
injury_reports.summary: Hooker posted five tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 27-24 loss to Cleveland.

injury_reports.name: Timmy Horne
injury_reports.summary: The Titans signed Horne from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylon Jones
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jonah Laulu
injury_reports.summary: The Titans claimed Laulu off waivers from the Raiders on Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Winston logged 14 tackles (eight solo) during the Titans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Thomas Morstead
injury_reports.summary: The Titans elevated Morstead from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Joey Slye
injury_reports.summary: Slye made his only field-goal attempt while going 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Tommy Townsend
injury_reports.summary: Townsend (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Dorian Mausi
injury_reports.summary: Mausi (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Germie Bernard
injury_reports.summary: Bernard caught three of five targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Rico Dowdle
injury_reports.summary: Dowdle carried the ball nine times for 41 yards and caught all six of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over New Orleans.

injury_reports.name: Pat Freiermuth
injury_reports.summary: Freiermuth caught two of four targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Johnson
injury_reports.summary: The Steelers elevated Johnson from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: DK Metcalf
injury_reports.summary: Metcalf two of six targets for 56 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Aaron Rodgers
injury_reports.summary: Rodgers completed 19 of 30 passes for 212 passes and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints. He added six yards on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Mason Rudolph
injury_reports.summary: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ben Skowronek
injury_reports.summary: Skowronek (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Smith
injury_reports.summary: The Steelers signed Smith off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Warren
injury_reports.summary: Warren carried the ball 18 times for 101 yards and caught three of four targets for 36 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Darnell Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington caught his lone target for a four-yard touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints in Paris.

injury_reports.name: Brandin Echols
injury_reports.summary: Echols (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Queen
injury_reports.summary: Queen compiled 10 tackles (seven solo), including 1.0 sacks, during Pittsburgh's win over the Saints on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Doneiko Slaughter
injury_reports.summary: Slaughter (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Watt
injury_reports.summary: Watt (calf) practiced fully Friday and doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Payton Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson totaled six tackles (three solo) and an interception during Pittsburgh's win over the Saints on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chris Boswell
injury_reports.summary: Boswell made each of his three field-goal attempts and his lone extra-point try in a 16-10 victory over the Saints on Sunday in Paris.

injury_reports.name: DeShon Elliott
injury_reports.summary: Elliott (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris.

injury_reports.name: Sebastian Joseph-Day
injury_reports.summary: Joseph-Day (triceps) was placed on injured reserve by the Steelers on Thursday, Teresa Varley of the team's official website reports.

items.name: Ben Skowronek
items.impact: Reported Questionable: WR starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Brandin Echols
items.impact: Reported Out: depth at CB may be affected.

items.name: Doneiko Slaughter
items.impact: Reported Out: depth at CB may be affected.

items.name: Sebastian Joseph-Day
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at DT may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Denzel Boston
injury_reports.summary: Boston caught three of eight targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Fannin caught six of nine targets for 91 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Dillon Gabriel
injury_reports.summary: The Browns activated Gabriel (back) from injured reserve Monday.

injury_reports.name: Tytus Howard
injury_reports.summary: Howard has cleared the league's concussion protocol and doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Steelers, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

injury_reports.name: Jerry Jeudy
injury_reports.summary: NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports that the Browns are currently "less likely" to trade Jeudy before the Nov. 10 deadline.

injury_reports.name: Jaleel McLaughlin
injury_reports.summary: McLaughlin turned five kickoff returns into 117 yards during the Browns' 27-24 win over the Titans on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Carsen Ryan
injury_reports.summary: The Browns elevated Ryan from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Dylan Sampson
injury_reports.summary: Sampson (knee) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Deshaun Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson completed 25 of 36 passes for 308 yards with an interception in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans. He added 19 yards and a touchdown on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Mike Hall Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Hall (ankle) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Steelers, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

injury_reports.name: Myles Harden
injury_reports.summary: Harden (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

injury_reports.name: Ronnie Hickman
injury_reports.summary: Hickman registered 10 tackles (six solo) and a fumble recovery during Sundays' 27-24 win over Tennessee.

injury_reports.name: Daniel Thomas
injury_reports.summary: Thomas (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

injury_reports.name: Jared Verse
injury_reports.summary: Verse (knee) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Steelers, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

injury_reports.name: Quincy Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams finished Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans with 10 tackles (seven solo).

injury_reports.name: Kalia Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis (quadriceps) will spend the rest of the 2026 season on injured reserve after his 21-day practice window expired Tuesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury_reports.name: DeAndre Carter
injury_reports.summary: The Lions signed Carter to the active roster Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
injury_reports.summary: Gibbs (shoulder) practiced fully Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Jared Goff
injury_reports.summary: Goff completed 22 of 32 passes for 303 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Sam LaPorta
injury_reports.summary: LaPorta caught one of two targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
injury_reports.summary: St. Brown (ankle) practiced in full Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Isaac TeSlaa
injury_reports.summary: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jameson Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught five of nine targets for 91 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over Green Bay.

injury_reports.name: Brian Branch
injury_reports.summary: Branch recorded four tackles (one solo) and an interception during Sunday's 20-17 win over Green Bay.

injury_reports.name: Jack Campbell
injury_reports.summary: Campbell tallied 11 tackles (eight solo) during the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Roger McCreary
injury_reports.summary: McCreary (foot) is questionable for Sunday's Week 8 matchup against Minnesota.

injury_reports.name: Ennis Rakestraw Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Rakestraw (ankle) does not have a game designation for Sunday's Week 8 tilt versus the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Rock Ya-Sin
injury_reports.summary: Ya-Sin (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Jake Bates
injury_reports.summary: Bates went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Ben Bartch
injury_reports.summary: The Lions placed Bartch (foot) on injured reserve Friday.

injury_reports.name: Kerby Joseph
injury_reports.summary: Joseph (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Cade Mays
injury_reports.summary: Mays (wrist) was activated from injured reserve Saturday and no longer has an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Isiah Pacheco
injury_reports.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

injury_reports.name: Devin White
injury_reports.summary: The Lions placed White (forearm) on injured reserve Friday.

items.name: Roger McCreary
items.impact: Reported Questionable: CB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Kerby Joseph
items.impact: Reported Out: depth at S may be affected.

items.name: Ben Bartch
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at G may be affected.

items.name: Devin White

items.name: Isiah Pacheco
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at RB may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Addison
injury_reports.summary: Addison caught two of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts. He added three yards on his lone carry.

injury_reports.name: DeeJay Dallas
injury_reports.summary: The Vikings elevated Dallas from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Christian Darrisaw
injury_reports.summary: Darrisaw (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Hockenson
injury_reports.summary: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Justin Jefferson
injury_reports.summary: Jefferson caught four of seven targets for 44 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Jauan Jennings
injury_reports.summary: Jennings caught two of three targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Jones (knee) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Lions, Dane Mizutani of the St. Paul Pioneer Press reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Jurgens
injury_reports.summary: Jurgens (elbow) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Murray
injury_reports.summary: Murray completed 14 of 24 passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts. He added 39 rushing yards on five carries.

injury_reports.name: Myles Price
injury_reports.summary: Price (head) was back on the field for the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Colts, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Cashman
injury_reports.summary: Cashman recorded 12 tackles (8 solo) including 2.0 sacks and four passes defensed during Sunday's 16-10 win versus the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith recorded four tackles (two solo) including 0.5 sacks and an interception during Sunday's 16-10 win versus the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Jay Ward
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Will Reichard
injury_reports.summary: Reichard went 3-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Mason
injury_reports.summary: Mason and Aaron Jones (knee) will share the backfield against the Lions on Sunday after the latter avoided an injury designation for Week 8, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Allen (hamstring) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Nate Boerkircher
injury_reports.summary: Boerkircher caught both of his targets for eight yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Josh Cameron
injury_reports.summary: Cameron didn't garner a target and recorded 46 kickoff-return yards during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Travis Hunter
injury_reports.summary: Hunter caught all four of his targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans in London. He also recorded three tackles and an interception.

injury_reports.name: Trevor Lawrence
injury_reports.summary: Lawrence completed 24 of 41 passes for 306 yards and four touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.

injury_reports.name: Jakobi Meyers
injury_reports.summary: Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Colts, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Rodriguez rushed 11 times for 55 yards while failing to reel in his only target during Sunday's 34-31 loss to Houston.

injury_reports.name: Brenton Strange
injury_reports.summary: Strange caught five of seven targets for 44 yards during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Thomas didn't haul in either of his two targets during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans in London.

injury_reports.name: Bhayshul Tuten
injury_reports.summary: Tuten carried the ball 12 times for 39 yards and caught all four of his targets for 48 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Parker Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington caught four of 11 targets for 64 yards in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Montaric Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Antonio Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Eric Murray
injury_reports.summary: Murray (concussion) does not have an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Foyesade Oluokun
injury_reports.summary: Oluokun logged eight tackles (four solo) in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans in London on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Cam Little
injury_reports.summary: Little made his sole field-goal attempt and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans on Sunday in London.

injury_reports.name: Ross Matiscik
injury_reports.summary: Matiscik (shoulder) does not have a game designation for Sunday's clash against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Anton Harrison
injury_reports.summary: Harrison was diagnosed with a torn ACL while undergoing a procedure on his right knee Thursday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.name: Antonio Johnson
items.impact: Reported Out: S starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Jakobi Meyers
items.impact: Reported Questionable: WR starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Anton Harrison
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at OT may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Mo Alie-Cox
injury_reports.summary: Alie-Cox failed to haul in either of his targets during the Colts' 16-10 loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Keenan Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen caught all three of his targets for 31 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Josh Downs
injury_reports.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Friday that Downs will perform his usual role Sunday against Jacksonville in spite of the fact that he requested a trade this week, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: DJ Giddens
injury_reports.summary: Giddens did not play a single snap during Sunday's 13-10 loss to the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Gould
injury_reports.summary: Gould (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 8 tilt against Jacksonville.

injury_reports.name: Daniel Jones
injury_reports.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that Jones will remain the team's starting quarterback in Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

injury_reports.name: Will Mallory
injury_reports.summary: Mallory did not catch any of his three targets during Sunday's 16-10 loss to Minnesota.

injury_reports.name: Seth McGowan
injury_reports.summary: McGowan turned 11 carries into 46 yards, caught his only target for two yards and added 140 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Drew Ogletree
injury_reports.summary: Ogletree (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Taylor
injury_reports.summary: The Colts are fielding trade offers for Taylor, and while the asking price currently appears to be "too high," a deal seems likely to happen, per NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

injury_reports.name: Laquon Treadwell
injury_reports.summary: Treadwell caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Colts' 16-10 loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Warren
injury_reports.summary: Warren (groin) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Mike Chappell of FOX59 reports.

injury_reports.name: Adetomiwa Adebawore
injury_reports.summary: Adebawore finished Sunday's loss to Minnesota with five tackles (four solo), including 2.0 sacks, and a defensed pass.

injury_reports.name: CJ Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen (ankle) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Boettcher
injury_reports.summary: Boettcher (groin) is questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Akeem Davis-Gaither
injury_reports.summary: Davis-Gaither recorded seven tackles (three solo) in Sunday's loss to Minnesota.

injury_reports.name: Sauce Gardner
injury_reports.summary: Gardner (calf) practiced in full Thursday.

injury_reports.name: A.J. Haulcy
injury_reports.summary: Haulcy produced nine tackles (five solo) in a loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Justin Walley
injury_reports.summary: Walley (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Alec Pierce
injury_reports.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Taylor-Britt
injury_reports.summary: The Colts placed Taylor-Britt on injured reserve Tuesday due to a groin injury, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

injury_reports.name: Braelon Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen is slated to serve as the Jets' starting running back Sunday against the Raiders, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Omar Cooper Jr.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis logged a five-yard carry and caught all three of his targets for 49 yards during Sunday's 28-25 loss to Miami. He also added a tackle on special teams.

injury_reports.name: Breece Hall
injury_reports.summary: Hall (quadriceps), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, isn't expected to play, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Adonai Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell failed to haul in any of his three targets during the Jets' 28-25 loss to the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Max Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Kene Nwangwu
injury_reports.summary: Nwangwu was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Dylan Parham
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Kenyon Sadiq
injury_reports.summary: Sadiq caught his lone target for six yards in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Geno Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith completed 23 of 30 passes for 287 yards, three touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins. He also rushed twice for no gain and threw a successful two-point conversion.

injury_reports.name: Mason Taylor
injury_reports.summary: Taylor caught all five of his targets for 62 yards and two touchdowns while adding a two-point conversion in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Garrett Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson said Wednesday that he won't ask to be traded from the Jets, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: David Bailey
injury_reports.summary: Bailey (groin) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Dane Belton
injury_reports.summary: Belton registered nine tackles (six solo) in Sunday's loss to the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Demario Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis finished Sunday's Week 7 loss to Miami with three tackles (two solo) and one defensed pass.

injury_reports.name: Minkah Fitzpatrick
injury_reports.summary: Fitzpatrick posted 10 tackles (six solo) Sunday in a loss to Miami.

injury_reports.name: Kiko Mauigoa
injury_reports.summary: The Jets placed Mauigoa (quadriceps) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Joseph Ossai
injury_reports.summary: Ossai (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: Jamien Sherwood
injury_reports.summary: Sherwood totaled eight tackles (four solo) and two defensed passes Sunday in a loss to Miami.

injury_reports.name: Jason Sanders
injury_reports.summary: Sanders went 1-for-2 on field-goal tries and made both of his extra-point attempts during Sunday's 28-25 loss to Miami.

injury_reports.name: Tim Patrick
injury_reports.summary: Patrick did not garner a target during Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: T'Vondre Sweat
injury_reports.summary: The Jets placed Sweat (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jack Bech
injury_reports.summary: The Raiders activated Bech (forearm) from injured reserve Saturday, and he does not carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Brock Bowers
injury_reports.summary: Bowers (calf) was a full practice participant Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Kirk Cousins
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Klint Kubiak said that Cousins will remain the Raiders' starting quarterback heading into Sunday's game against the Jets, Paul Gutierrez of the team's official site reports. "There is no controversy," Kubiak said. "He is playing at a very high level."

injury_reports.name: Ashton Jeanty
injury_reports.summary: Jeanty rushed eight times for 15 yards and brought in all eight targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Michael Mayer
injury_reports.summary: Mayer caught all three targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 35-21 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Fernando Mendoza
injury_reports.summary: Mendoza did not appear in Sunday's 35-21 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Nailor
injury_reports.summary: Nailor caught two of five targets for 14 yards during Sunday's 35-21 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Jackson Powers-Johnson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Ian Thomas
injury_reports.summary: Thomas (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Raiders reinstated Thornton (hamstring) from injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Tre Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker secured five of 12 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Mike Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Washington rushed six times for 27 yards in Sunday's 35-21 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Cody White
injury_reports.summary: White caught one of three targets for four yards in Sunday's 35-21 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Jeremy Chinn
injury_reports.summary: Chinn finished Sunday's Week 7 loss to the Rams with seven tackles (three solo). He also recovered a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Nakobe Dean
injury_reports.summary: Dean produced 12 tackles and an interception in Sunday's loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Johnson
injury_reports.summary: The Raiders placed Johnson (neck) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Carter Runyon
injury_reports.summary: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Davis Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen caught four of five targets for 20 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Tutu Atwell
injury_reports.summary: Atwell wasn't targeted in Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Blake Corum
injury_reports.summary: Corum rushed 17 times for 93 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for eight yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Higbee
injury_reports.summary: Higbee caught two of three targets for 14 yards during Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Konata Mumpfield
injury_reports.summary: Mumpfield caught one of two targets for 15 yards during Sunday's 35-21 win at Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: Bill Murray
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Puka Nacua
injury_reports.summary: Nacua brought in eight of 10 targets for 68 yards and a touchdown and rushed twice for 10 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Colby Parkinson
injury_reports.summary: Parkinson (ribs) is inactive for Sunday's Week 8 matchup against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Ty Simpson
injury_reports.summary: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Chargers but will serve as the team's emergency quarterback if needed.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Stafford
injury_reports.summary: Stafford completed 23 of 29 passes for 195 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed three times for minus-3 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Keagen Trost
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Kyren Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams rushed 16 times for 99 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for 22 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Kam Curl
injury_reports.summary: Curl logged four tackles (two solo) during the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Desjuan Johnson
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Quentin Lake
injury_reports.summary: Lake finished Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders with seven tackles (four solo).

injury_reports.name: Nate Landman
injury_reports.summary: Landman (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chargers, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Joe Cardona
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Joshua Karty
injury_reports.summary: The Rams elevated Karty from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Davante Adams
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

injury_reports.name: Terrance Ferguson
injury_reports.summary: Ferguson (ankle) won't return to practice this week, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

injury_reports.name: Myles Garrett
injury_reports.summary: The Rams are optimistic that Garrett (knee) will be able to return to practice in Week 9, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Joe Alt
injury_reports.summary: Alt (neck) was not listed on the Chargers' official injury report Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Kayode Awosika
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Oronde Gadsden
injury_reports.summary: Gadsden is active for Sunday's Week 8 matchup against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Omarion Hampton
injury_reports.summary: Hampton rushed seven times for 18 yards and caught all four of his targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Tre' Harris
injury_reports.summary: Harris (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Justin Herbert
injury_reports.summary: Herbert completed 22 of 37 passes for 204 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 22-6 loss to the Chiefs. He also rushed five times for 26 yards.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Johnston
injury_reports.summary: Johnston's role in the passing game will shrink slightly in Week 8 against the Rams given that both Ladd McConkey (concussion) and Tre' Harris (hamstring) have been cleared to play, Eric Smith of the Chargers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Charlie Kolar
injury_reports.summary: Kolar caught three of six targets for 20 yards during the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith

injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Kage Casey
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Jonah Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman said Friday that he'll be ready for a larger role if that's what the team needs in the absence of RJ Harvey, who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Kansas City due to a knee injury, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: J.K. Dobbins
injury_reports.summary: Dobbins and Jonah Coleman will lead the Broncos' backfield against the Chiefs on Sunday due to the absence of RJ Harvey (knee), Eric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Sam Ehlinger
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Evan Engram
injury_reports.summary: Engram caught one of three targets for two yards during Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Troy Franklin
injury_reports.summary: Franklin failed to bring in either of his two targets in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Mims (ankle) practiced fully Thursday,Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Bo Nix
injury_reports.summary: Nix completed 15 of 29 passes for 222 yards and a touchdown while rushing seven times for 73 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Gavin Ortega
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Cody Schrader
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos elevated Schrader from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Courtland Sutton
injury_reports.summary: Sutton caught three of five targets for 45 yards during Sunday's 30-16 win over Arizona.

injury_reports.name: Talanoa Hufanga
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Jordan Jackson
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Tyler Onyedim
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Taylor Rapp
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos signed Rapp off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Alex Singleton
injury_reports.summary: Singleton recorded 19 tackles (12 solo) including 1.0 sacks during Sunday's 30-16 win at Arizona.

injury_reports.name: Pat Surtain II
injury_reports.summary: Surtain (ankle) was a full practice participant Wednesday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Wil Lutz
injury_reports.summary: Lutz went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made all three of his PATs during Sunday's 30-16 win over Arizona.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Badie
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos placed Badie (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: RJ Harvey
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Armstrong
injury_reports.summary: Armstrong caught one of two targets for three yards during Sunday night's 20-3 loss to Seattle.

injury_reports.name: Noah Gray
injury_reports.summary: Gray caught three passes on as many targets for 44 yards during Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Emmett Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught two of three passes for 17 yards and returned three kickoffs for 81 yards during Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks. He also added two tackles on special teams.

injury_reports.name: Travis Kelce
injury_reports.summary: Kelce (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Mahomes
injury_reports.summary: Mahomes completed 19 of 33 passes for 165 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks. He added two rushing attempts for 14 yards.

injury_reports.name: Jaylon Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Broncos.

injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Diego Pounds
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Rashee Rice
injury_reports.summary: Rice (hamstring) will play in Sunday's game against the Broncos, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Ben VanSumeren
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Kenneth Walker III
injury_reports.summary: Walker rushed 14 times for 36 yards while catching four of five targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Worthy
injury_reports.summary: Rashee Rice (knee/hamstring) has no injury designation for Sunday's game against the Broncos, so Worthy will move back into his WR2 role for Week 8.

injury_reports.name: Nick Bolton
injury_reports.summary: Bolton registered 11 tackles (six solo) during the Chiefs' 20-3 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chamarri Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to Seattle with seven tackles (two solo).

injury_reports.name: Mansoor Delane
injury_reports.summary: Delane (shoulder) has been downgraded from questionable to out for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Drue Tranquill
injury_reports.summary: Tranquill finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 12 tackles (four solo).

injury_reports.name: Nohl Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 10 tackles (four solo) and one interception.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Butker
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Andy Reid said Wednesday that Butker will "probably" serve as the Chiefs' kicker in Sunday's game against the Broncos, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

injury_reports.name: Omarr Norman-Lott
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs designated Norman-Lott (knee) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: L'Jarius Sneed

injury_reports.summary: Brown (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Efton Chism III
injury_reports.summary: Chism caught his sole target for 16 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: DeMario Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas caught three of his four targets for 23 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: TreVeyon Henderson
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Hunter Henry
injury_reports.summary: Henry secured all seven targets for 71 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Corey Kiner
injury_reports.summary: Kiner rushed four times for 13 yards in Thursday's Week 7 loss to Chicago. He also returned four kickoffs for 102 yards.

injury_reports.name: Lan Larison
injury_reports.summary: The Patriots signed Larison off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Drake Maye
injury_reports.summary: Maye completed 24 of 31 passes for 321 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding four rushes for 26 yards and another score in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Ryan Miller
injury_reports.summary: The Patriots elevated Miller from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Behren Morton
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Eli Raridon
injury_reports.summary: Raridon caught three of four targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's Week 7 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson rushed six times for 22 yards and brought in all five targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams returned two kickoffs for 47 yards and failed to haul in his lone target during the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Channing Canada
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Elliott Davison
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Marcus Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones registered nine tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks, and returned one punt for 19 yards in Thursday's loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Karon Prunty
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Andy Borregales
injury_reports.summary: Borregales made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three extra-point tries Thursday in a Week 7 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Marcus Bryant
injury_reports.summary: Bryant (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Mike Kadlick of CLNSMedia.com reports.

injury_reports.name: John Bates
injury_reports.summary: Bates (shoulder) is active for Sunday night's matchup with the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Dyami Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown hauled in his only target for six yards during Monday's 23-17 loss versus San Francisco.

injury_reports.name: Treylon Burks
injury_reports.summary: Burks (foot) is listed as active Sunday versus the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Stefon Diggs
injury_reports.summary: Diggs (hand/hamstring) was a full practice participant Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Austin Ekeler
injury_reports.summary: Ekeler logged a three-yard carry and caught both of his targets for four yards during the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Van Jefferson
injury_reports.summary: The Commanders signed Jefferson to the active roster Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
injury_reports.summary: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Commanders' emergency third quarterback Sunday night against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Jaylin Lane
injury_reports.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Marcus Mariota
injury_reports.summary: Mariota (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Chig Okonkwo
injury_reports.summary: Okonkwo brought in all seven targets for 69 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Tanoa Togiai
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Antonio Williams
injury_reports.summary: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Javon Kinlaw
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Fabian Moreau
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Charles Omenihu
injury_reports.summary: Omenihu (groin/ankle) is active for Sunday night's contest against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Daron Payne
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Sonny Styles
injury_reports.summary: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

injury_reports.name: Isaac Yiadom
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Drew Stevens
injury_reports.summary: Stevens made his only field-goal try and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-17 loss at San Francisco.

injury_reports.name: Terry McLaurin
injury_reports.summary: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremy McNichols
injury_reports.summary: McNichols accrued five rushes for 13 yards during Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

injury_reports.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
injury_reports.summary: Newton (pectoral) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Laremy Tunsil
injury_reports.summary: Tunsil (triceps) could potentially return late in the season, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Bradford
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_reports.summary: Charbonnet (knee) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Charles Cross
injury_reports.summary: Cross (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Sam Darnold
injury_reports.summary: Darnold completed 20 of 28 passes for 257 yards, one touchdown and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Chiefs. He added two rushing attempts for 17 yards.

injury_reports.name: George Holani
injury_reports.summary: Holani turned five carries into 11 yards and caught one of two targets for 12 yards during the Seahawks' 20-3 win over the Chiefs on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tory Horton
injury_reports.summary: Horton failed to haul in his lone target and returned two kickoffs for 60 yards during the Seahawks' 20-3 win over the Chiefs on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Velus Jones Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Cooper Kupp
injury_reports.summary: Kupp caught both of his targets for 20 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Drew Lock
injury_reports.summary: Lock (elbow) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Bears, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Rashid Shaheed
injury_reports.summary: Shaheed (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bears, Curtis Crabtree of FOX 13 Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Nick Emmanwori
injury_reports.summary: Emmanwori registered four tackles (two solo) Sunday in a 20-3 Week 7 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Ernest Jones IV
injury_reports.summary: Jones notched nine tackles (five solo) Sunday in a 20-3 win against Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Tyrice Knight
injury_reports.summary: Knight (hip) doesn't have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Byron Murphy II
injury_reports.summary: Murphy (back) does not have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Uchenna Nwosu
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Patrick O'Connell
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Connor O'Toole
injury_reports.summary: O'Toole (hamstring) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Pili
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Chazz Surratt
injury_reports.summary: Surratt (calf) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Drake Thomas
injury_reports.summary: Thomas (ankle) practiced in full Friday, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Leonard Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (Achilles) was a full practice participant Friday, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Jason Myers
injury_reports.summary: Myers went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday night's 20-3 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Jadarian Price
injury_reports.summary: Price (chest) doesn't have a designation for Monday's game against the Bears but remains on injured reserve, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Luther Burden III
injury_reports.summary: Burden brought in all four targets for 130 yards and a touchdown and rushed once for seven yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Roschon Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson rushed twice for 13 yards in the Bears' 30-24 victory over the Patriots on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Colston Loveland
injury_reports.summary: Loveland (neck) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Ben Johnson told reporters Saturday that Monangai (thumb/toe) will not play against the Seahawks on Monday, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Rome Odunze
injury_reports.summary: Odunze brought in four of five targets for 69 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Kalif Raymond
injury_reports.summary: Raymond did not catch either of his two targets and returned one punt for seven yards Thursday in a 30-24 win over New England.

injury_reports.name: Sam Roush
injury_reports.summary: Roush is expected to get more work on offense after Cole Kmet (knee) landed on injured reserve Friday.

injury_reports.name: Zavier Scott
injury_reports.summary: Chicago signed Scott from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: D'Andre Swift
injury_reports.summary: Swift rushed 22 times for 78 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 12 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams completed 22 of 33 passes for 308 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing five times for 18 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Edwards
injury_reports.summary: Edwards (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Monday's tilt against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Gordon
injury_reports.summary: Gordon recorded five tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: D'Marco Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (ankle) is questionable to suit up Monday versus Seattle.

injury_reports.name: Malik Muhammad II
injury_reports.summary: Muhammad (toe) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Jack Sanborn
injury_reports.summary: Sanborn (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Jeffery Simmons
injury_reports.summary: Simmons was traded to the Bears on Thursday, along with a 2028 fifth-round pick, in exchange for first-round picks in 2027 and 2028, as well as a 2027 fourth-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyrique Stevenson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson (hip) is active for Thursday night's contest against New England.

injury_reports.name: Montez Sweat
injury_reports.summary: The NFL reinstated Sweat on Friday after he served a two-game suspension for violating the league's performance-enhancing substances policy.

injury_reports.name: Dillon Thieneman
injury_reports.summary: Thieneman tallied eight tackles (three solo), including 0.5 sacks, in a 30-24 victory versus the Patriots on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Cairo Santos
injury_reports.summary: Santos went 3-for-4 on field-goal tries and made all three of his extra-point attempts in Thursday's 30-24 win over New England.

injury_reports.name: Coby Bryant
injury_reports.summary: Coach Ben Johnson said Wednesday that Bryant (knee) will start running again in the "near future," Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Cole Kmet
injury_reports.summary: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.
